trace_field_contract.actual_acceleration: world spatial acceleration at deck origin [linear_xyz,angular_xyz], m/s^2 and rad/s^2
trace_field_contract.actual_pose: world deck-origin pose [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz], m and unit quaternion
trace_field_contract.actual_twist: world spatial twist at deck origin [linear_xyz,angular_xyz], m/s and rad/s
trace_field_contract.command_acceleration: world spatial left-limit integration target acceleration at integration_target_time_s [linear_xyz,angular_xyz], m/s^2 and rad/s^2
trace_field_contract.command_pose: world deck-origin left-limit integration target pose at integration_target_time_s [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz], m and unit quaternion
trace_field_contract.command_twist: world spatial left-limit integration target twist at integration_target_time_s [linear_xyz,angular_xyz], m/s and rad/s
trace_field_contract.deck_tracking_pose_error: world pose error at sample_time_s: actual minus right-limit command, [translation,rotation-vector], m and rad
trace_field_contract.integration_application_time_s: mocap write time for q(t), episode-relative seconds
trace_field_contract.integration_target_time_s: left-limit target q(t) evaluated for integration, episode-relative seconds
trace_field_contract.sample_application_time_s: mocap write time for q(t+dt), episode-relative seconds
trace_field_contract.sample_target_acceleration: world spatial right-limit target acceleration at sample_target_time_s [linear_xyz,angular_xyz], m/s^2 and rad/s^2
trace_field_contract.sample_target_pose: world deck-origin right-limit target pose at sample_target_time_s [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz], m and unit quaternion
trace_field_contract.sample_target_time_s: right-limit target q(t+dt) evaluated after integration, episode-relative seconds
trace_field_contract.sample_target_twist: world spatial right-limit target twist at sample_target_time_s [linear_xyz,angular_xyz], m/s and rad/s
trace_field_contract.sample_time_s: post-integration state sample data.time, episode-relative seconds
trace_field_contract.warning_lastinfo: post-step MuJoCo warning.lastinfo per warning type
trace_field_contract.warning_number_delta: post-step delta of MuJoCo warning.number since previous sample
trace_field_contract.weld_constraint_force_raw: MuJoCo efc_force rows for this weld at sample_time_s, raw constraint-coordinate order
trace_field_contract.weld_constraint_residual_raw: MuJoCo efc_pos rows for this weld at sample_time_s, raw constraint-coordinate order
